label: Receipt & Expense Processor
description: Extracts and categorizes expense receipts from descriptions or OCR output. Classifies by expense type, VAT deductibility (per Swedish/EU tax rules), and cost center. Produces structured expense report.

claudeKnowledge.description: Swedish VAT rules (Mervärdesskattelagen), EU VAT Directive, Skatteverket expense deductibility guidelines

guidedInputs.label: Expense receipts or OCR output
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste OCR output, receipt descriptions, or a list of expenses. Include: vendor, date, amount, currency, and any description from the receipt.

e.g.
- Taxi 2025-02-10, 245 SEK, Bolt, Stockholm city centre
- Lunch 2025-02-11, 1 320 SEK, Operakällaren, client meeting with Nordea
- Hotel 2025-02-12-13, 3 600 SEK, Radisson Blu, overnight Göteborg conference

guidedInputs.label: Available cost centers (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List your cost centers for allocation.
e.g.
- 1100: Client delivery
- 1200: Business development
- 2000: Internal / overhead
- 3000: Training & conference

guidedInputs.label: Expense policy rules (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Any specific company expense policy rules to check against.
e.g. Meals capped at 500 SEK/person, hotel max 2 000 SEK/night, receipts required above 200 SEK.
